# m.stocks.filings.insider_activity

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Open-market insider purchases and sales, summed per company and transaction day.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.stocks.filings.insider_activity(symbols=None, *, issuer_cik=None, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Query methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `IssuerCik`, `TransactionDate` and `Symbol`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Tickers whose issuers to return; None, the default, for every issuer. |
| `issuer_cik` | The issuing company's SEC CIK, as text with its leading zeros, or a sequence of them; None, the default, for every issuer. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first transaction date. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last transaction date. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | The field to sort by, such as `"net_value"`; the default is the newest transaction date first. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Unused today: the arguments above reserve every endpoint parameter, so any key raises `ValueError`. Keys: none. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Insider Trading Activity (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The ticker the request named that the row lists in `Tickers`: a row that lists several of the named tickers appears once for each, so an article about AAPL and MSFT read for both is listed under each. A request that named one ticker gives it to every row. Null when the call named no ticker, and on a row that lists none of a request's named tickers. |
| `IssuerCik` | String | SEC Central Index Key of the issuer company (10 digits, zero-padded). |
| `IssuerName` | String | Name of the issuer company as reported in the filings. |
| `LastFilingDate` | String | Filing date of the latest filing that reported one of these transactions (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). Transactions are usually filed within two business days. |
| `NetShares` | double | Shares purchased minus shares sold. |
| `NetValue` | double | Value purchased minus value sold in USD. |
| `PlannedPurchaseValue` | double | Value of shares purchased under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan in USD. Zero on filings before the plan checkbox was introduced in 2023. |
| `PlannedSaleValue` | double | Value of shares sold under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan in USD. Zero on filings before the plan checkbox was introduced in 2023. |
| `PurchaseCount` | long | Number of open-market purchase transactions. |
| `PurchaseShares` | double | Shares purchased. |
| `PurchaseValue` | double | Value of shares purchased in USD. |
| `PurchaserCount` | long | Number of distinct insiders who purchased. |
| `SaleCount` | long | Number of open-market sale transactions. |
| `SaleShares` | double | Shares sold. |
| `SaleValue` | double | Value of shares sold in USD. |
| `SellerCount` | long | Number of distinct insiders who sold. |
| `Tickers` | String[] | Ticker symbols of the issuer as of the transaction date. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes; the totals cover the issuer, not each ticker. |
| `TransactionDate` | String | Date of the transactions (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
